title: Quick Korean-Style Crispy Vietnamese Pork Banh Mi
description: A delicious and easy Korean-Style Crispy Vietnamese Pork Banh Mi recipe featuring a tangy, crunchy, and keto-friendly twist on the classic Vietnamese dish. This recipe is perfect for kids and adults alike!
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the pork shoulder, Korean chili flakes, fish sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger. Mix well to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the vegetable oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Meanwhile, toast the banh mi bread slices by grilling them in a toaster or under the broiler.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading a layer of pickled carrots on the bottom slice of bread, followed by a few slices of pork, a few slices of cucumber, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Drizzle the rice vinegar over the top of the banh mi and serve immediately.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make additional banh mi.
